literature_rate_cells.meaning: Saved source-preparation rate cells with measured subject/experiment retained in the referenced sheet. Conditional statistics are not annotation probabilities or target-transfer scores; unavailable operands remain null with reasons.

literature_rate_source_cells.meaning: The same saved numerical rate components from native source spans, with each arm's actual subject/construct/preparation bindings and approximation retained. Source-supported conditional statistical assumptions do not establish causal isolation, target transfer or annotation credit. This closed native return view is distinct from the legacy table view, not a second scoring sheet.

literature_quantity_cells.meaning: Saved single reported source quantities, with quantity and analyte identity. Untyped spread remains untyped. Source conditions, attribution and correction scores remain unknown where unsupported.

literature_assay_cells.meaning: Saved source-anchored assay interpretations and numerical operands/corrections. Endpoint and arrangement describe the episode's source interpretation. Known-normal indices remain conditional and are not function probabilities. Unknown operands remain null.

literature_ratio_cells.meaning: Reported comparative signal components with actual denominator/arrangement, received representation candidates and source origins. Conflicts are not sampling intervals. Calibration and functional response/uncertainty remain separate missing inputs.

literature_binding_cells.meaning: Saved source binding-parameter components with actual protein/state/ligand comparison, uncertainty basis and reported-limit arithmetic. Limits are not confidence or true-parameter bounds; IC50 is not Kd. Missing inputs and unimplemented observation models remain explicit.

literature_binding_model_cells.meaning: Saved conditional source log-parameter contrast, full-covariance noise and signed likelihood/index components for test parameter exceeding reference. Known/estimated variance, actual censor mechanism and model origin stay explicit. Native reporting limits are not point observations or confidence bounds; these are not probabilities of function or target-transfer scores.

literature_transport_cells.meaning: Saved native concentrations and conditional same-curve kinetic-response components. condition_response is test substrate saturation divided by reference substrate saturation under the same fitted curve. Keep actual curve/preparation identities, Km uncertainty meaning and full covariance ownership. The response can divide an appropriate source effect once; it is not reliability or annotation credit. Missing or different curves remain unavailable.

component.description: condition_response is test substrate saturation divided by reference substrate saturation under the same fitted kinetic curve. It can divide an appropriate source effect once as a conditional response correction; it is not a reliability grade.

literature_perturbation_cells.meaning: Saved reference-perturbation effects and proposed restoration components, retaining actual recipient/construct/partner and endpoint meanings. Calibrated same-endpoint contrasts, real restoration, nuisance comparability and effect isolation are distinct. Missing quantitative outcomes and uncertainty remain unknown. The proposed source index is not target correspondence or annotation credit.

component.description: Native reference/perturbed/restored outcomes and separate effect, restoration, nuisance amount and isolation components. The reference index combines their declared orientation and proposed conventions; it is not target correspondence or probability. Joint uncertainty remains unreported.

literature_structure_cells.meaning: Saved conditional source-model geometry and local residue RSCC components with exact source bindings. Entry/revision validation, fixed required panels, proposed physical predicates and unreported coordinate/measurement uncertainty remain explicit. Conditional state/assignment identities do not establish population occupancy, causal isolation or target annotation credit.

literature_reaction_cells.meaning: Saved reported reference reaction-ratio residuals, fixed named-prediction comparisons and simple resource budgets. Source summary uncertainty and incomplete resources remain explicit unknowns. Product-pair ratios and supplied reagent coverage do not establish consumption, native capacity or measured coupling. Logical domain bounds are not confidence intervals; no target correspondence or annotation credit is calculated.

literature_context_cells.meaning: Saved organism/sample compatibility bounds with the original capability-versus-coverage question, actual context frame, weights, pairing, mapping and domain qualifications. Unpaired fractions use bounds; unexamined biological situations remain unknown. Conditional Hoeffding sampling is separate from logical domains and requires the actual independent context design. Source assay observations are not additional biological samples, target-transfer weights or annotation credit.

literature_figure_cells.meaning: Saved native experimental graph ordinates and signed differences with both molecule/partner arms, endpoint/normalization, source representation relationships and repeat/spread meanings. Bounds describe conditional pixel digitization, not SD or confidence intervals. Coupled product or partner-swap differences do not establish upstream-only activity, partner necessity, target correspondence or annotation credit.

literature_partner_cells.meaning: Saved experimental partner-removal and addback components with actual molecule/partner identities, nonpartner-condition comparisons, normalization, physical observation identity and reported spread meanings. Native rates survive unavailable controlled comparisons. Bounds condition on supplied censor domains and exact reported means; they are not sampling confidence. Directed condition-specific dependence does not establish universal necessity, genomic presence, coexpression, target correspondence or annotation credit.

literature_amount_cells.meaning: Saved A105 source amount components with both quantities' actual roles, preparation/stock, method, basis, qualification and covariance ownership. Target/total mass-fraction estimates differ from nominal molar arm comparisons. Conditional denominator conversion is not applied to a rate; uncertainty and unknown relationships remain explicit, without target correspondence or annotation credit.

literature_optical_cells.meaning: Saved projections of existing net_rate(q) and variance_net_rate(Vq) inputs for the source NADH-depletion endpoint, conditional on the selected optical relationships. Preserve actual subject/construct/preparation/conditions, source qualifications, local reuse and covariance ownership. This is not isolated product formation, recovery k, protein amount, corrected activity, target transfer, annotation credit or independent evidence from another rate representation.

literature_kinetic_cells.meaning: Saved native kinetic parameter and descriptive contrast components, preserving per-operand subject/construct, source protocols, qualification and actual uncertainty meanings. Only the five native cells are supported by this route. Its covariance/model source reader is unimplemented, not a source finding. Ratio, difference and log contrast are dependent representations, not independent experimental support or annotation credit.

literature_binding_interaction_cells.meaning: Eight saved native source binding-discrimination interaction components for two molecular forms and two ligands. A requested raw parameter row alone expands that role's numerical source readings and partial uncertainty. Derived rows preserve source meaning/status references without unrequested operand numbers. Unknown common kind does not imply IC50; the model/covariance source reader is unimplemented, not a paper omission. No target transfer or annotation credit.
